threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think a tube strike is just a minor inconvenience instead of the apocalypse it actually is.
Saw a guy trying to impress a girl by rapping about the bus route. She was laughing, but the bus driver wasn’t having it. Classic Brixton vibes.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I stumbled upon an underground pétanque court in a hidden park, I knew Neukölln had more surprises up its sleeve than I ever expected.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a hidden kebab stand with a line that wraps around the block, open till sunrise, serving the best post-party döner.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they nod at the taco truck guy like he’s family, even if they just ordered a burrito.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a tuxedo juggling outside the Civic Center station while Muni was delayed. Just another day in the city where anything can happen.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is all about tourists. But the real charm? It's the hidden patios where locals sip vermut, not the busy squares.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by how they clutch a map in front of a bar, looking up and down the street as if waiting for a sign.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think it's odd when someone in a cafe asks for your name before handing over a coffee. Welcome to the barista culture!
Caught the N35 last night; three lads were arguing over who could name the most obscure South London park. Only in Brixton!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I found a cat lounging on my balcony, completely unbothered, and realized it belonged to my neighbor who’d always feed strays on our street.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you sip a club mate on the street while a DJ spins vinyl from a pop-up sound system at 3 AM. It's a vibe you won't find anywhere else.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by how they know to avoid the 24th Street bus during rush hour—yet still hop on for the free wi-fi.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenading passengers at the Civic Center station, entire bus stop clapped as the Muni pulled away. Just another day, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all locals hit the bars after 10 PM. Most of us have our dinner by then and are tucked in by midnight, not dancing till dawn.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They'll be the ones struggling with the ‘pato’ accent while confidently ordering in English at the boqueria.
